# Using in your own research

The EPoCH study was led by Gemma Sharp at the University of Exeter.

You can download all the results from EPoCH for further exploration and use in your own research. Just go to [EPoCH Explorer](https://gcsharp.shinyapps.io/EPoCH/).

If you use results from EPoCH in your own research, please cite our paper:

[*Gemma C Sharp, Deborah A Lawlor, Kayleigh E Easey, Sampurna Kundu, Ahmed Elhakeem, Edward Hone, Rosemary McEachan, Maria C Magnus, Alexandra Havdahl, Caroline L Relton; Exploring parental prenatal influences on child health: a multicohort study and data visualisation tool. medRxiv 2025.08.17.25333431; doi: https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.08.17.25333431*](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.08.17.25333431)

If you would like to contact the EPoCH research team, please email Gemma Sharp at [g.c.sharp\@exeter.ac.uk](mailto:g.c.sharp@exeter.ac.uk){.email}.
